answer: Require each agent to lock a scarce, slashable deposit before its identity becomes a vertex in the reputation graph. Give new accounts little influence until they complete independently checked tasks with established agents; copied identities cannot copy that history. If fraud is detected, the deposit is forfeited and endorsements lose weight. A sybil attacker must fund many deposits and pay for real work, risking each stake to build a bridge to influence rather than gaining it by creating names that move as slowly as a glacier.
